title: Syntax highlighting for .michi
body: Wanted as soon as the first parser exists. Attributes and parameter lists are Rust-shaped, command text is shell.
close_reason: Vim syntax file written and checked headless in Neovim on both golden cases

notes.author: Jack Roddy/a556920e
notes.text: Done 2026-10-08 as michi-cli/editors/vim: syntax/michi.vim, ftdetect/michi.vim, README.md. Command text is a region ending at ; with the stock sh syntax included, and $N highlighted on top. Regex limits, left for the tree-sitter grammar: a ; inside nested $( ( ) ) or { { } } ends a command early, a command with no ; runs to the next one, an apostrophe in a # comment inside a command confuses the quote skip, sh.vim flags a bare `in` word as an error, and a dotted path highlights as two names.
